plan_item: 77.44.7.D — element-specific content and media; related to 49.4 published asset delivery

defect.observed: The published legacy page renderer resolves image/video/audio props.assetId and a safe video's props.posterAssetId to /media/{id}; media.ts previously authorized those references only when authored-content version metadata was present, so the published renderer could emit a URL that returned 404.
defect.fix: Published-reference discovery now matches the legacy renderer for image, video, audio and video posters. Existing type/MIME compatibility, safe video-source validation, page/site scope, published visibility/tree reachability, and archive checks remain in place.
defect.savePublish: Unchanged: draft-only references remain private; the public route continues to inspect published content only. Save and Publish remain separate.

reuseReview.used: Existing project-owned legacy page renderer, Media Registry route, fixture uploader and D1/R2 fixture; behavior was aligned across the existing components.
reuseReview.externalCode: None. No new dependency or paid service.

tests.coverage: Published legacy image, video, audio and video-poster IDs return the exact stored bytes and MIME; legacy unsafe video sources, unrelated nodes, hidden/unpublished references and scope controls remain covered.
Existing 390px/desktop authored-media, Canvas and public renderer parity regression; the current route fix is separately exercised by the local route fixture above.

tests.note: The first attempt could not resolve the local test dependency graph; after using the already-present complete local dependency tree, the Worker+D1/R2+Chromium fixture produced no output and remained running beyond its 180-second test timeout, so the run was stopped. No production resource was used.

tests.notes: Dry-run only; no deployment. Wrangler log path was redirected to writable /tmp after the container's default /home/agent/.config path returned EROFS.
